scope: Independent read-only analysis of saved copied runs. Original screenshots are unchanged. No source changes or client launches. Matching capture tick/view is compared across different runs; this is not an aligned pixel-difference test.
blackPixelCriterion: Diagnostic proxy: mean luma on 0..255 scale <5 AND near-black RGB<=3 fraction >0.75. Appropriate to this unobstructed bright platform/sky test world; not a universal scene-visibility rule.
performanceScope: Per-capture Minecraft FPS display only. Capped at 60, individual samples influenced by resource warmup. No GPU timings or benchmark conclusion.
evidenceLimits: The original 114-check runs predate explicit BlendMode cache/factor instrumentation. Their saved GL stages cannot independently prove cache restoration.
No-GUI frames retain an earlier GUI-pre sample with its own tick. Do not use that stale entry as current render-end evidence.
The early baseline third-person blackout was missed by the old runtime mean<1.5 and nearBlack>.975 proxy; independent widened criteria and raw image review detect it.
